source: Bairoch, P., Batou, J., Chevre, P. (1988), La population des villes europeennes 800-1850, Geneva: Droz. Figures in thousands per century, taken here from the manual transcription by Jacob W. Russ (github.com/JakeRuss/bairoch-1988, bairoch-1988.csv), column 1500. Round estimates, not census counts.
note: Bairoch lists a city only when it passes his size threshold; null means not listed for 1500, not zero. Tangier is not in this data bank. These figures are NOT yet used by the game: data/world.json keeps its design numbers until the balance PR.
